title: Hospital cash claims
subtitle: A working insurance reference for an engineering interview
rows: Customer intake to a recorded human decision
Evidence, identity checks and a recoverable payout ledger
Real Java and Python services running in the cloud
notes: Independent project, not an official Turaco system. All customers, policy terms and transfers are invented. Open the presentation hub in a second tab before starting. Allow about 10 minutes including the live demo. Source: README.md and docs/cloud-presentation.md.

title: A claim needs more than extracted fields
subtitle: The difficult part is deciding when the system is allowed to act
rows: A customer can correct dates after the first intake
A matching document still needs a reviewed evidence decision
A payment timeout can hide a completed transfer
notes: Explain the failure cases before the technology. Confirmation is invalidated by material corrections. Evidence conflicts require human resolution. An uncertain payout must be reconciled against an authoritative receipt before another transfer is considered. Source: docs/architecture.md and docs/threat-model.md.

title: The live application keeps its original stack
subtitle: Cloudflare serves the interview materials and forwards the app
rows: Browser → Cloudflare → Codespaces dashboard gateway
Java API → PostgreSQL: claim state, audit and payout ledger
Keycloak: roles and tokens · Python: extraction and workflow
Provider simulator: invented evidence and payment outcomes
notes: Only dashboard port 5173 is public. Identity administration and database ports remain private. The gateway forwards requests to the existing stack rather than replacing it with a Worker simulation. Docker builds and Kubernetes checks also run in CI. Source: .devcontainer/compose.cloud.yaml, infrastructure/cloudflare/src/worker.js and docs/cloud-presentation.md.

title: Human authority sits between intake and payment
subtitle: The benefit calculation is deterministic
rows: Intake → customer confirmation → assisted verification
Submit → reviewer recommendation → approver reservation
Simulated transfer → receipt → reconciliation
Three covered nights produce KES 4,500 in the invented policy
notes: Use a fresh claim for the live sequence. Enter a different synthetic evidence reference for confirmation and assisted verification. The reference clears after each success. A paid claim cannot be confirmed again. If an action returns 409, the UI refreshes the claim and shows the failure beside the controls. Source: apps/claims-dashboard/src/main.jsx and docs/cloud-presentation.md.

title: An unknown payout is not a failed payout
subtitle: Recovery preserves the original attempt
rows: Create one simulated payout with an UNKNOWN result
Block a blind retry while its outcome is unresolved
Record a separate mock receipt from the simulator
Reconcile to CONFIRMED and inspect the audit history
notes: This is the key failure demonstration. Show the attempt identifier and audit trail before and after reconciliation. Do not describe this as real money movement or imply a real disbursement contract exists. Source: scripts/cloud-demo-check.py and tests/e2e/full_platform.py.

title: AI proposes structured data; policy controls the action
subtitle: Provider adapters and durable recovery have explicit boundaries
rows: OpenAI and Anthropic adapters validate schema and provenance
LangGraph supports durable conversational recovery
Uncertain extraction and conflicting evidence require review
Speech and OCR remain unsupported or human-assisted
notes: The hosted demonstration uses deterministic fixtures and simulators, not live model or provider approvals. Four invented extraction fixtures are regression checks, not representative language certification. Do not claim production Swahili or speech accuracy. Source: docs/decisions/SDLC-status.md and docs/decisions/EXTRACTION-run-17-evaluation.json.

title: Verification covers the workflow and its failures
subtitle: Both CI workflows passed at application checkpoint 8c27c14
rows: Java/PostgreSQL tests, Python tests and dashboard regression
Authenticated cloud smoke and all six synthetic E2E phases
Container builds, dependency scans and Kubernetes demo checks
Release 0.2.0 has separate source and checksum evidence
notes: Latest application checkpoint: 8c27c1440a2ea605e20738cfaa15cb4b9b7b3a32. CI: https://github.com/kimtour/turaco-insurance/actions/runs/38880620013 and https://github.com/kimtour/turaco-insurance/actions/runs/38880619991. Historical release run 17 had 23 Java, 17 Python and eight release-tool tests; its 24935a7 source is distinct from later cloud and UI fixes. Source: docs/decisions/SDLC-status.md.

title: Live walkthrough
subtitle: Use a fresh synthetic claim and keep the audit trail visible
rows: Sign in as approver with the published fixture password
Create intake, confirm, verify, submit and approve
Show UNKNOWN recovery using a separate mock receipt
Inspect one correction and the resulting state history
notes: Demo: https://turaco-presentation.kimani-mutua.workers.dev/workspace/ . Fixture: approver / local-demo-only. Resume the Codespace before the interview. If unavailable, use the hosted screenshots and workflow explanation; do not present them as a currently live transaction. Guide: https://turaco-presentation.kimani-mutua.workers.dev/documents/docs/cloud-presentation.html .

title: The remaining work is production integration
subtitle: This is a synthetic reference with a working cloud demonstration
rows: Real identity, payee and product-term enrollment
Provider, messaging, privacy and country approvals
Representative language/media evaluation and retention design
Managed operations, backups and a funded availability plan
notes: The owner selected free compute and confirmed a $0 Codespaces budget with blocking. The workspace sleeps after 30 minutes of inactivity and cannot promise always-on access. Cloudflare keeps the deck, documents, handoff and release downloads available independently. Finish by opening the public source and the handoff. Source: docs/decisions/SDLC-status.md and docs/cloud-presentation.md.
